epoching.aggregation: per-PRN componentwise median using only rows whose timestamp is inside the bin
epoching.duplicate_policy: exact duplicate scientific rows are fatal
epoching.schedule: epoch k is [0.02*k,0.02*(k+1)) anchored to recording start

cleanstatic_roles.history_rule: No epoch or raw sample may occur in more than one role. Predictor/state histories reset at each role, scenario, segment, channel/PRN identity change, or gap; the first 0.20 s after reset is ineligible. Score windows must be wholly contained in one role.

inner_roles.containment: All are half-open; no raw sample, epoch, history, score window, covariance edge, or state-prior edge crosses an inner-role boundary.

signed_q.complex_normalization: For C_E,C_P,C_L, divide each signed I/Q component by sqrt(|C_E|^2+|C_P|^2+|C_L|^2)+epsilon_i; epsilon_i is fit only on cleanStatic train-fit [30,140), excluding guard [140,150) and validation [150,210), then frozen before calibration.
forbidden_inputs: PRN ID as a numeric feature

field_semantics.carr_error_hz: Wrapped Costas PLL discriminator in cycles, not Hz; direct range loading is CONDITIONAL on the closed_loop_transfer_jacobian preflight, including wrapping and linear range.
field_semantics.carr_error_filt_hz: Bit-identical to carrier_doppler_hz on cleanStatic; excluded from signed_q as a duplicate and never a separate innovation.
field_semantics.code_error_chips: Source-comment unit ambiguity remains; direct range loading is CONDITIONAL on the closed_loop_transfer_jacobian preflight.
field_semantics.carrier_doppler_hz: NCO state level; only its frozen one-step VAR residual may carry range-rate loading after transfer preflight.
field_semantics.code_frequency_offset_chips_s: NCO state offset level; only its frozen one-step VAR residual may carry range-rate loading after transfer preflight.
field_semantics.complex_EPL: Covariance-only with zero direct geometry loading; no separate source/synthetic Jacobian is preregistered.

signed_q.innovation_rule: Every scientific innovation is the frozen one-step VAR residual. No discriminator, loop-filter, or NCO raw field is itself called an innovation.

h0_predictor.fit: ridge least squares pooled over eligible PRN histories with one shared intercept and one shared coefficient matrix per lag; no PRN parameters
h0_predictor.ridge_selection: Use train-fit [30,140), guard [140,150), validation [150,210), all half-open; minimize arithmetic mean one-step squared error on the exact common eligible validation support, relative ties within 1e-12 choose larger ridge.

normal_whitening.mean: Per ordered q channel Huber-1.345 location from eligible per-PRN one-step VAR residuals.
normal_whitening.covariance: Ledoit-Wolf Sigma_train on centered eligible per-PRN residual vectors.
normal_whitening.eigendecomposition: Symmetrize Sigma_train as (Sigma+Sigma^T)/2, compute numpy.linalg.eigh, and form the symmetric inverse square root V*diag(floored_eigenvalue^-1/2)*V^T.
normal_whitening.eigenvalue_floor: max(1e-8*largest_eigenvalue,1e-8 absolute if largest_eigenvalue is zero); negative/nonfinite largest eigenvalue is validity failure.
normal_whitening.coordinates: Gamma is estimated only after this pooled per-PRN whitening, in z coordinates.
normal_whitening.conditioning: none; calibration and attacks fit no score-function parameter

hypotheses.H0: Frozen normal VAR residual model with no extra coordinated input.

geometry.code_error_chips: CONDITIONAL direct range row only after closed_loop_transfer_jacobian proves receiver equation, unit, sign, wrapping/linear range, loop path, and VAR-transferred gain.
geometry.pll_phase_error_cycles: CONDITIONAL direct range row only after closed_loop_transfer_jacobian proves wrapped Costas equation, unit, sign, linear range, loop path, and VAR-transferred gain.
geometry.carrier_doppler_hz: CONDITIONAL range-rate loading on the frozen one-step VAR residual of this NCO state level only.
geometry.code_frequency_offset_chips_s: CONDITIONAL range-rate loading on the frozen one-step VAR residual of this NCO state offset only.
geometry.complex_EPL_channels: zero direct geometry loading; covariance-only because no separate source/synthetic Jacobian is preregistered
geometry.predictor_transfer: G is the direct physical design after the exact frozen one-step VAR lag operator and preflight-proved closed-loop signed gain; signs/scales/lags may never be chosen from attacks.

hypotheses.geometry_sign_preflight: Before any protected attack rows are opened, a clean/synthetic source-verified unit test must confirm DLL/PLL/Doppler sign conventions. Failure makes A3, A4, and Full UNAVAILABLE; no sign may be selected from attacks.

state_prior.model: constant velocity for delta_p/delta_b with smooth random walks for delta_v/delta_bdot
state_prior.selection: Use config.lambda_selection exactly; Full/A3/A4 share Full-selected lambda.
state_prior.estimator_role: fixed-prior penalized MAP linear smoother used only to estimate state
state_prior.F_phys: with dt=0.02 s: p_next=p+v*dt; b_next=b+bdot*dt; v_next=v; bdot_next=bdot
state_prior.precision_definition: R is the unique physical-coordinate precision induced by the exact normalized prior objective above.
state_prior.reset: Every role/segment/gap reset starts a new theta_0 prior; no prior edge crosses a reset.

closed_loop_transfer_jacobian.sources: source-byte-hash and deterministic source/synthetic tests only; no attack selection
required_for_each_requested_direct_row: deterministic impulse signed gain through the one-step VAR transfer
deterministic ramp signed gain through the one-step VAR transfer

rows.carrier_doppler_hz: CONDITIONAL one-step-residual range-rate row from NCO state
rows.code_freq_chips: CONDITIONAL one-step-residual range-rate row from NCO state

closed_loop_transfer_jacobian.row_failure: Set that requested direct row loading to exactly zero before protected access.
closed_loop_transfer_jacobian.method_failure: If remaining proved code-range/carrier-range/range-rate geometry is insufficient for A3, A4, or Full, mark the affected method UNAVAILABLE and set validity INVALID_EXPERIMENT_NO_ATTACK_ACCESS.
closed_loop_transfer_jacobian.verdict_rule: Transfer invalidity/unavailability is not a scientific NO-GO and protected rows remain sealed.

source_synthetic_vectors.initialization: all physical states and loop/NCO perturbation states exactly zero
source_synthetic_vectors.rate_step_ramp: rhodot=+0.001 m/s for k>=10; rho is accumulated causally from zero using dt=0.02 s
source_synthetic_vectors.wrapping: disabled only for these epsilon tests after proving epsilon lies inside the exact source linear range; verify the wrap boundary separately at its exact source threshold
required_matches: each direct pre-VAR q shift equals analytic B_t*x_t

var_transfer.history: pre-window x and q_shift history is exactly zero after reset
var_transfer.assembly: Stack exact observed g_t rows in epoch, numeric-PRN, frozen-channel order, then apply the lower-Cholesky C_t^(-1/2) solve.
var_transfer.uniqueness: This is the only G used for MAP/EDF. Apply the frozen shared VAR exactly once and never a second transfer.

method_availability.A3: requires at least one validated range row: code_error_chips or carr_error_hz-semantic-cycles
method_availability.A4: requires at least one validated rate row: code_freq_chips_s or carrier_doppler_hz
method_availability.Full: requires A3 and A4, plus at least one validated code-family row and at least one validated carrier-family row

geometry_observability.matrix: M_t has rows [-u_i,t^T,1] with PRNs sorted numerically.
geometry_observability.svd: numpy.linalg.svd(M_t,full_matrices=False); sigma_max=sigma_1; numeric rank counts singular values >1e-10*sigma_max.
geometry_observability.same_range_rate_rule: The identical M_t rank/condition test applies to range and rate geometry.
geometry_observability.g_scaling: G uses the already-frozen physical state scaling D.
geometry_observability.epoch_failure: Epoch unavailable; if required observations/PRNs remain insufficient, window unavailable.
geometry_observability.claim_rule: Position-vs-clock claims require rank=4 and kappa<=1e4 at every included epoch.
geometry_observability.zero_rule: If sigma_max is zero/nonfinite or sigma_4 is nonpositive/nonfinite, rank/condition fails and the epoch is unavailable.

candidate_pre_var_q_shifts.code_freq_chips_s: -rhodot_i,t/code_chip_m; CONDITIONAL on source NCO sign/unit preflight
candidate_pre_var_q_shifts.carrier_doppler_hz: -rhodot_i,t/lambda_L1_m; CONDITIONAL on source NCO sign/unit preflight

direct_local_physical_jacobian.source_column_semantics: The source column carr_error_hz is semantically carr_error_cycles.
direct_local_physical_jacobian.opposite_sign_rule: If a source equation has the opposite preregistered sign, the preflight fails and that row loading is zero/unavailable. No silent flip; any alternate convention requires a new preregistration before attack access.

score.estimator: fixed-prior penalized MAP linear smoother used only to estimate x
score.observed_coordinates: y is stacked common-nuisance-whitened Z on the exact finite observed coordinates; G is the correspondingly whitened H1 design after frozen VAR and closed-loop transfer.
score.interpretation: penalized observation-RSS improvement plus one explicit effective-DoF BIC penalty; raw RSS improvement alone is forbidden
score.linear_algebra: Use stable solves; pseudoinverse is permitted only with frozen rcond=1e-10.

thresholds.source: cleanStatic calibration scores only; calibration fits or conditions no score-function parameter
thresholds.scores: Emit scores from the fully frozen train-fitted model, covariance, Gamma, transfer, lambda, and support rules.
thresholds.nearest_rank: For q in {0.99,0.995}, sort n finite eligible calibration scores ascending and select zero-based index ceil(q*n)-1.
thresholds.dependence_note: Temporal dependence prevents finite-sample conformal coverage; false-alarm validity is empirical via cleanStatic holdout and provenance-valid external pre-onset gates.

persistent_alarm.schedule: Evaluate causally at each current emitted score on scheduled 0.5 s slots.
persistent_alarm.definition: Current endpoint is persistent iff at least 3 of the trailing 5 consecutive scheduled slots, including current, have score>threshold.
persistent_alarm.missing_rule: Any unavailable or missing slot breaks the run; it is neither a non-alarm nor bridgeable.
persistent_alarm.assignment: Persistent status belongs only to the current endpoint and is never assigned retroactively.
persistent_alarm.first_persistent_alarm: First current score availability endpoint satisfying the trailing 3-of-5 rule.
persistent_alarm.control_failure: Any eligible non-clock control has persistent-alarm ratio >0.10 or a run of 10 consecutive available alarm slots at any frozen threshold.

bootstrap.boundary_rule: A score ending exactly at a 10-s boundary belongs to the preceding block whose data it uses.
bootstrap.final_block: Include only if duration>=5 s; otherwise discard.
bootstrap.score_eligibility: The complete 1-s window must lie in both the phase and assigned block.
bootstrap.resampling: Resample blocks with replacement within cell to original block count, preserving paired rows/masks. After resampling, recompute equal row weights within each cell and equal total cell weights.
bootstrap.ds7_ds8_family: Sample a family block index and include corresponding available DS7/DS8 members; never independent clusters. Pre-110 replay excluded.
bootstrap.percentile: Nearest-rank without interpolation: sort B=2000 values; index=ceil(q*B)-1 zero-based, clamped to [0,B-1].
bootstrap.boundary: No block crosses role, phase, or scenario.

implementation_must_include_and_pass.criterion: Every feature, residual, state window, and alarm at time t uses no sample after t.
Fit, model selection, whitening, calibration, and thresholds use only their frozen cleanStatic roles.
No raw sample index occurs in more than one train/calibration/holdout role or crosses a role-contained score window.
No derived epoch occurs in more than one train/calibration/holdout role.
Timestamp derivation, half-open timeline intervals, onset, pull-off, and score availability anchors match the frozen contract.
Source/synthetic tests prove units and signs for every physical loading; ambiguity fails closed without attack-based selection.
Any PRN ordering permutation leaves scores and availability unchanged within numeric tolerance.
Valid variable PRN sets score consistently and fewer than four PRNs yields unavailable, never an imputed score.
Each relation-destruction control preserves every preregistered marginal/support condition and breaks only its stated relation.
Effective DoF equals trace(A) of the fixed-prior MAP smoother observation influence on exact observed coordinates and is included exactly once in the BIC penalty.
All compared methods use the exact same eligible event, epoch, and PRN mask; an unavailable event is removed from every method.
Two clean runs with seed 23 produce byte-identical scientific tables and JSON after canonical serialization.
Every required artifact passes SHA-256, size, path, ordering, recursion, and temporary-file exclusions.
A fresh clone at the pinned commit verifies inputs, reruns tests and the clean-only pipeline, and reproduces required outputs without untracked dependencies.
Source/synthetic-only preflight proves every requested direct row and deterministic impulse/ramp VAR-transferred gain before attack access.
Train-only deterministic Gamma estimator, PSD floor, and identical H0/H1 nuisance covariance pass.
Per-epoch rank=4 LOS checks and state-scaled stacked condition number<=1e4 pass.
With rcond=1e-10, 0<=trace(A)<=rank(G)<=n_obs and penalty is counted exactly once.
Epoch/window anchors, right-end availability, phase containment, missing-slot breaks, and causal trailing 3-of-5 pass.
Cell-balanced pooling and aligned paired block bootstrap, including DS7/DS8 family clustering, match the frozen equations.
A1, A2, and A5 equations, training sources, priors, resets, thresholds, and contrast-specific support pass.
Every mandatory holdout-only control and level is generated with verified semantics or validity fails before protected access.
Invalidity writes invalid_run.json and cannot emit or masquerade as a scientific final verdict.
Prove Sigma symmetric whitening, z-only median Gamma fit, arithmetic centering, independent c_t, exact C_t/blockdiag, and deterministic lower-Cholesky solves.
Prove exact B formulas/signs/test vectors, one-and-only-one VAR transfer, zero reset history, observed stacking, and C whitening.
Prove exact inner roles, common lambda support, per-window GCV, relative tie, minimum 100 windows, and sharing rules.
Prove cell/row weights, exact float64 ties, grouped ROC, alpha interpolation, trapezoid normalization, and paired support.
Prove nextafter endpoint blocks, full-window containment, post-resample weights, family clustering, and nearest-rank indices.
Prove SHA256-derived 128-bit big-endian PCG64 seeds, canonical orders, seed recording, and exact control stages/formulas.
Prove exact invalid set/schema, canonical manifest membership, target/evidence commits, and verification PASS distinct from science validity.

verification_contract.failure_effect: Scientific/semantic integrity failure => INVALID_EXPERIMENT_NO_ATTACK_ACCESS before attack access. Administrative packaging mismatch => VERIFICATION_ADMIN_WARNING and repaired verifier PASS before delivery.

protected_access_contract.preflight: Before any protected read, resolve the canonical path; classify scenario/phase/row range; verify authorization, source checksum, size, timeline, and allowlist; reject directories, globs, prior-result paths, and unclassified reads.
protected_access_contract.trace_rule: Append an immutable record before and after every protected access; a missing, mismatched, or retroactively created trace invalidates the experiment.

normal_common_mode.fit_source: eligible cleanStatic train-fit [30,140) epochs only; N_t>=4; no attack conditioning
normal_common_mode.epoch_summary: For each epoch t, m_t is the coordinatewise median across numerically sorted valid PRNs of z_i,t.
normal_common_mode.matrix: Stack m_t as rows in increasing epoch order; center each q channel by its arithmetic train-fit mean.
normal_common_mode.estimator: Ledoit-Wolf Gamma on the centered m_t row matrix, in z coordinates only.
normal_common_mode.eigenvalue_floor: Symmetrize Gamma; numpy.linalg.eigh; floor eigenvalues at 1e-8*largest eigenvalue, or 1e-8 absolute when largest eigenvalue is exactly zero; negative/nonfinite largest eigenvalue is validity failure.
normal_common_mode.temporal_model: c_t are independent across epochs; there is no temporal covariance beyond the frozen per-PRN VAR prediction.
normal_common_mode.epoch_covariance: For N_t valid PRNs and observed q rows, C_t=I_(N_t*q)+(1_N*1_N^T) kron Gamma, restricted to exact observed coordinates.
normal_common_mode.window_covariance: For the 50 epochs of an eligible 1-s window, C=blockdiag(C_t) in chronological order.
normal_common_mode.whitening: Apply deterministic numpy.linalg.cholesky lower factor L_t of C_t and solve L_t*y_white=y and L_t*G_white=G at each epoch; never form an explicit inverse.
normal_common_mode.failure: Cholesky failure makes the epoch/window unavailable and triggers the frozen preflight validity rule when mandatory Full cannot remain available.
normal_common_mode.permutation_rule: Covariance construction is invariant to PRN permutation; canonical storage/orders use numeric PRN and frozen q schema index.

evaluation_schedule.epoch: epoch k=[0.02*k,0.02*(k+1)) from recording start; availability is right endpoint
evaluation_schedule.score_window: window j=[0.5*j,0.5*j+1.0) from recording start; availability is right endpoint
evaluation_schedule.eligibility: Window wholly inside one frozen role/phase; every residual prediction uses only prior epochs from that same role/segment after reset and 0.20 s warmup.
evaluation_schedule.pre_onset_fpr: Both the full window and its availability endpoint are strictly within the half-open pre-onset phase; endpoint equal to onset is excluded.
evaluation_schedule.phase_metrics: Full score window must be inside the half-open phase; straddling windows are unavailable.

validity_contract.failure_rule: Write invalid_run.json, attack_access_count=0, do not open protected rows, and do not emit final_verdict.json.
validity_contract.control_boundary: Pre-protected validation requires successful generation and semantic verification of mandatory control transforms, not their alarm behavior. Alarm behavior is scientific G5 after valid access; poor behavior yields scientific NO-GO in an otherwise valid run.

examples: plot PNG byte hash when plot data source is unchanged
admin_warning.effect: May be repaired in an evidence-only descendant commit without changing scientific tables or verdict; final delivery still requires repaired verifier PASS.

verifier_contract.exit_semantics: Exit 0 only on PASS; nonzero on FAIL.
fresh_clone_requirements: checkout target_commit exactly, independent of branch
clean-only deterministic reproduction when run status permits
no silent dependency on original-worktree untracked files

report_field_types.all_other_required_fields: nonempty string except hashes are 64 lowercase hex

field_semantics.commit: alias of target_commit for backward schema compatibility; must equal target_commit
field_semantics.target_commit: commit containing the scientific or validly fail-closed invalid artifacts being verified
field_semantics.evidence_commit: commit containing verifier reports; may equal target_commit or be an evidence-only descendant
field_semantics.overall_status: PASS when verification behavior succeeds, including correctly confirming a fail-closed invalid run
field_semantics.exit_code: 0 means verification PASS, not scientific GO; nonzero means verification FAIL

verifier_contract.invalid_run_verification: On invalid runs, checks use the exact invalid required set and overall_status PASS means the verifier correctly confirmed fail-closed invalidity.

inner_roles.containment: All are half-open; no raw sample, epoch, history, score window, covariance edge, or state-prior edge crosses an inner-role boundary.

lambda_selection.support: For each method, intersect eligible lambda-validation windows across all four lambda candidates before computing any objective.
lambda_selection.objective: Arithmetic mean GCV_w across the common eligible lambda-validation windows.
lambda_selection.tie_rule: For objectives g1,g2, tie iff abs(g1-g2)<=1e-12*max(abs(g1),abs(g2),1); choose larger lambda.
lambda_selection.nonfinite: Any nonfinite RSS, n, nu, GCV, or mean objective makes that lambda/method unavailable.

weighted_pauc.weights: Let C_pos and C_neg be included positive and negative cell counts. Each positive cell has total weight 1/C_pos and each row in it weight 1/(C_pos*n_cell); each negative cell analogously has total 1/C_neg and row weight 1/(C_neg*n_cell).
weighted_pauc.support: NaN/unavailable rows are removed from every method in that contrast by exact paired support.
weighted_pauc.ordering: Cast scores to float64, sort descending, and group scores for which float64 numeric equality (==) is true; update every row in an equal-score group simultaneously. NaN is unavailable and absent by paired support.
weighted_pauc.curve: Start (FPR,TPR)=(0,0); append grouped cumulative points; linearly interpolate TPR at FPR=0.05 if required.
weighted_pauc.integration: Trapezoid-integrate TPR over FPR in [0,0.05] and divide by 0.05.
weighted_pauc.unavailable: No positive or no negative total weight.
weighted_pauc.denominators: Total positive and negative weights are each exactly 1 before cumulative ROC construction.

deterministic_randomness.recording: Record NumPy version and every seed material plus derived integer seed in physical_controls.json or relation_destruction_metrics.json.
deterministic_randomness.component_encoding: Use exact machine-readable identifiers; block_id is base-10 integer b; integer levels are base-10; float levels use Python format(value,".17g"); missing/not-applicable components use literal NA; object_id is the frozen semantic object identifier.

scenario_relation_policy.single_class_rule: Use paired score-loss bootstrap within relation cells; never invoke binary pAUC on an isolated single-class cell.

invalid_run_contract.manifest_membership: Include every invalid required file except artifact_manifest_sha256.json, verifier_report.json, and fresh_clone_verifier_report.json.
invalid_run_contract.extra_artifacts: forbidden; access_ledger.jsonl is the complete access trace for invalid runs
